disclosure: Five distinct critique lenses; simulating them with one model is not independent peer review.

roles.name: Evidence & Sources
roles.mission: For each claim retrieve the original publication and exact figure/table/method line; label unsupported or misleading citation.

roles.name: Methods & Statistics
roles.mission: Challenge controls, design, sampling, power, effect size, confounding, leakage and extrapolation; cite primary methods.

roles.name: Adversarial Replication
roles.mission: Independently search contradictory and null findings, alternate explanations and replication status; explain uncertainty.

roles.name: Translation & Safety
roles.mission: Keep in-vitro, animal, computer, observational and randomized human evidence separate; catch clinical overclaims.

roles.name: Clarity & Reproducibility
roles.mission: Check novice explanation, original-versus-modern-method separation, chosen tool and a verifiable nonclinical task.
